title: A turbulent jet flame
subtitle: Sandia Flame D: methane and air, Reynolds number 22 400
hook: The flame every combustion model in the world is judged against.

media.alt: A 100 kW methane fire on a square burner: the flame sways and breaks up, and the hot plume rises
media.caption: The lab today: a 100 kW methane fire and its plume, low-Mach reacting flow in 3D, burning as fast as fuel and air mix. This flag needs the chemistry itself.
